content: Neon serverless driver 1.1.0 GA: neon() HTTP one-shot queries (64MB limit, template tags safe); transaction() for multi-query non-interactive txn; Pool/Client over WebSockets for interactive txns, node-postgres compatible; in serverless, Pool must be created+closed per request; Node 24 has global WebSocket (no ws pkg needed); pooled connection string uses -pooler hostname suffix; use DIRECT connection for migrations; PgBouncer transaction mode blocks SET/LISTEN/NOTIFY; retry logic recommended.
